translation_notes: The region is a test method: `self` is unused (driver passes None) and `sg` is the Oxigraph-backed graph of the real fixture; the driver substitutes a plain rdflib Graph (the oxigraph store is not the object of the study).

`sg.add((s, p, o))` becomes `@graph sg` + `+{ {s} {p} {o} }`; the two membership asserts `(s, p, o) [not] in sg` become `assert [not] m{ {s} {p} {o} }` (truthiness of a lazy match; precedent in the trav_existence stratum). s, p, o are kept as the original's Python tuple assignment (no refactoring), so the three terms are interpolated: for a ground triple the island is no shorter than `(s, p, o) in sg` - the gain is nil here, the notation is only uniform with the rest of the file.

Driver: three calls - empty graph (both asserts pass, one triple added), graph already holding the triple (first assert raises AssertionError, compared as a value), graph with only neighbours (alice knows carol, bob knows alice, alice likes bob, alice knows "bob") where a too-broad membership test would raise. Verified non-hollow: widening the first membership pattern to `?q` makes call 3 differ, and changing the added object makes calls 1 and 3 differ.
optimization_notes: optimized.py: the three names s, p, o become one `triple` tuple, used as is by both membership asserts and by sg.add; nothing else to compress.

Exception to the symmetry, island-only: in optimized.ldpy the terms are written in place as prefixed names under a computed prefix declared in the function, `@prefix ex: f<{EX}> .` (it still reads the EX constant), so no variable holds them; Python has no way to name the triple inside `in` and `add` other than a variable. `@graph sg` + `+{ }` for the add, `assert [not] m{ }` for the two membership tests.

Side effect stated: `@graph sg` designates the caller's graph and, by record ldpy/027, adds the block's ex: binding to its namespace manager (no binding is lost, the triples are unchanged; the driver compares by isomorphism). The call-suffix form `+{ }(sg)` / `m{ }(sg)` avoids it, at notation 1.0 instead of 0.79 on this region.
header_optimization_notes: Python: Literal goes; URIRef and the EX constant stay.
